## Summary

Verified and documented external MCP client compatibility against Supabase OAuth 2.1 server (PSI-078). FINDINGS: (1) Supabase Auth (GoTrue) advertises RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) at /auth/v1/oauth/clients/register; it does not natively resolve draft CIMD URLs directly without registration. (2) Claude Desktop: Fully supported out of the box via DCR and PKCE. Discovers registration_endpoint from /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, registers, and initiates /auth/consent. (3) Hermes Agent / CLI: Fully supported via DCR with PKCE S256 and ES256 JWT bearer tokens. (4) ChatGPT Actions / Custom GPTs: Supported via pre-registered static OAuth 2.0/2.1 credentials (generated via DCR or Supabase dashboard). (5) Cursor: Supported via direct Bearer JWT token in MCP headers. (6) Documented full setup guide, fallback mechanisms, and security in docs/backend-architecture/mcp-client-compatibility.md. (7) Unit tests in src/agent/__tests__/mcp-client-compatibility.test.ts (6/6 pass). Suite: 103 frontend tests pass, 15 edge function tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.
